_meta.usage: full landline number in national form (10 digits): 011-2345678, (081) 222 3456; drop a leading +94. A bare code is not accepted, so other countries' codes don't match
_meta.note: 29 geographic codes named after the exchange town; a code's area does not follow district borders, so each key lists every district it reaches. Cross-border coverage checked against OpenStreetMap: about 1,600 Sri Lankan landline numbers (rechecked 2026-10-27) from phone/contact:phone tags were placed in the 25 district polygons and counted by code; codes seen only on hotels, bank branches and chain head offices (e.g. 011 island-wide) were not counted, codes on local schools, councils, hospitals and shops were. A single local institution (council, school, hospital, post office, education office) is enough for a district; codes seen there only on hotels or companies (066 around Habarana and Sigiriya, 031 and 037 on companies) are left out. Four mappings (047 Ratnapura, 036 Kegalle, 027 Ampara, 081 Nuwara Eliya) come from government directories named in the source list.
_meta.miss_note: not a Sri Lankan geographic code: 07x mobile, or a code missing from the TRCSL list (e.g. 046, 060)
